mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token = #{token} AND is_revoked = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token, expires_at, is_revoked, created_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{token}, #{expiresAt}, #{isRevoked}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET is_revoked = true WHERE token = #{token}
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET is_revoked = true WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
